title: Scaling Qualitative Analysis with Large Language Models: Development and Validation of the Smart Coder Framework for Human-LLM Collaborative Coding
abstract: arXiv:2610.33205v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current uses of large language models (LLMs) for qualitative coding often rely on ad hoc prompting with limited guidance for reliability and human oversight. To address these limitations, we propose the Smart Coder Framework, a three-phase approach structuring human-LLM collaborative coding through Instruction, Prompt Strategy, and Reliability Check. We evaluated the framework using 72 middle-school mathematics teacher interview transcripts and a human-consensus benchmark. A factorial design compared instructed versus uninstructed prompts, few-shot versus few-shot plus chain-of-thought prompting, and single-pass versus self-consistency coding. Twelve transcripts were used for prompt development and calibration, and 60 for the formal evaluation. In the results, instruction consistently improved agreement. translated_title: 利用大语言模型规模化开展质性分析：面向人-大语言模型协作编码的Smart Coder框架的开发与验证
translated_abstract: 目前使用大语言模型（LLM）进行质性编码的方式通常依赖于临时性的提示方法，在可靠性和人工监督方面缺乏充分的指导。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了Smart Coder框架，这是一种通过指令、提示策略和可靠性检查三个阶段来结构化人-大语言模型协作编码的方法。我们使用72份中学数学教师访谈转录文本和一个人工共识基准对该框架进行了评估。研究采用因子设计，比较有指令提示与无指令提示、少样本提示与少样本加思维链提示、以及单次编码与自洽性编码。其中12份转录文本用于提示词的开发与校准，60份用于正式评估。结果显示，指令始终能提高一致性；在指令充分的条件下，思维链进一步提升了一致性，而自洽性带来的增益较小且依赖于主题。
tldr: 该论文提出并通过实证验证了Smart Coder框架，通过指令、提示策略与可靠性检查三阶段结构化人-大语言模型协作的质性编码流程，显著提升了LLM编码与人类共识的一致性。
en_tdlr: The paper develops and validates the Smart Coder Framework, a three-phase approach (Instruction, Prompt Strategy, and Reliability Check) that structures human-LLM collaborative qualitative coding and demonstrably improves agreement with human-consensus coding.
